details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- agents.md:129-170 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new tracking-issue comment contract is documented incompletely.
  WHY: The section omits the `.completion_status_failure_alert_sent` sentinel, the exact `<!-- status:<token> -->` grep contract, and the idempotent body-hash behavior downstream tools rely on.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~1279-1363 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: A failed GitHub API write still poisons the completion-status body-hash cache, so later polls treat the write as successful and stop retrying.
  WHY: The `gh_retry gh api` failures are swallowed and the cache file is written unconditionally, so a transient PATCH/POST failure can leave the pinned comment stale indefinitely.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~1291-1363 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `body_markdown` is interpolated into the comment body without escaping or validation.
  WHY: Today the callers are hardcoded, but any future dynamic content could break the rendered comment or the JSON payload.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~1307-1308 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The body-hash computation assumes `sha256sum` exists and does not check for failure.
  WHY: On a runner without `sha256sum`, the cache key can be empty or malformed, breaking the idempotency check.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~1308-1309 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The idempotency cache lives under `${TMPDIR:-/tmp}`, so it is lost between cron invocations.
  WHY: That limits deduplication to a single job run and causes the comment to be rewritten every poll cycle.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~1326-1343 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: When the `COMMENTS` cache is empty or the jq lookup misses, `existing_id` stays blank and the helper falls back to POST instead of PATCH.
  WHY: That can create duplicate completion-status comments across polls when the cache remains empty or stale.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~4710-4721 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The validation preflight checks `PROJECT_COMPLETE` before that flag is guaranteed to be initialized.
  WHY: On first-cycle or recovery paths, the guard treats unset as not gated, so validation can dispatch against a state that is not yet known complete.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~9976-10059 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The wave-status ladder recomputes `_completion_status_text` every cycle and can reset a previously terminal `validated` comment back to `ready`.
  WHY: After `mark_validation_complete`, later polls still enter the same decision block and overwrite the status tag based only on current project flags.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~9998-10027 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `implementation-failed` issues satisfy both the pending and failed jq filters, so the same issue is listed twice in one comment.
  WHY: The pending filter excludes only merged/closed/skipped, while the failed filter explicitly includes `implementation-failed`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10039-10043 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The same pending-filter omission causes the issue to appear in multiple display lists.
  WHY: Adding `implementation-failed` to the exclusion list would prevent duplication.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~10026-10034 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: When the compare API fails, the completion-status comment emits no integration-status line at all.
  WHY: The code only prints a line for the contained or ahead cases, so API failure and success-without-line are indistinguishable to operators.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~10046-10053 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The `completion_status_failure_alert_sent` flag is written with `jq ... > tmp && mv`, but the move result is not checked.
  WHY: If `mv` fails, the state file keeps `false` and the once-per-project Telegram alert can fire again on later cycles.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~1335-1348 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The body-hash idempotency cache is written even when the GitHub API write fails.
  WHY: The `gh_retry gh api` failures are swallowed, but the cache file is still updated, so later polls think the comment update succeeded and stop retrying.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~10005-10015 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: An `implementation-failed` issue appears in both the pending and failed sections of the pinned comment.
  WHY: The pending filter does not exclude `implementation-failed`, while the failed filter explicitly includes it, so the same issue is shown twice with contradictory semantics.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~10026-10034 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The completion-status comment omits any integration-status line when the compare API fails.
  WHY: The logic only emits a line for the contained or ahead cases, so compare failures are indistinguishable from a successful but silent state.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~10050-10053 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The once-per-project Telegram alert flag is persisted without checking whether the `mv` succeeded.
  WHY: If the state-file move fails, the flag stays false on disk and the alert can be sent again on the next poll cycle.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~1311 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `body_markdown` is concatenated into the comment body without validation or escaping.
  WHY: The current callers are hardcoded, but future dynamic content could break the rendered comment or the JSON payload.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~9976-10059 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Terminal `validated` status can be overwritten with `ready` on later poll cycles.
  WHY: The wave-status block recomputes the status from current flags every tick without preserving the terminal validated state.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10010-10018 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `implementation-failed` issues appear in both the pending-merge and closed-without-merge sections.
  WHY: The pending filter excludes only `merged`, `closed`, and `skipped`, while the failed filter explicitly includes `implementation-failed`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1340-1349 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Silent API failures poison the idempotency cache and prevent future retries.
  WHY: Both `gh api` branches use `|| true`, and the body hash is written afterward even if the comment update failed.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10050-10053 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `completion_status_failure_alert_sent` state update does not handle `mv` failure.
  WHY: If the move fails, the state file is unchanged but the function continues, so duplicate Telegram alerts can occur later.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1326-1334 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Empty or invalid `COMMENTS` can leave `existing_id` blank and force the wrong API path.
  WHY: When the lookup yields no match, the helper falls through to POST instead of PATCH, which can create duplicate comments over time.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~1291-1363 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Unvalidated markdown content is passed directly into the GitHub comment body.
  WHY: Malformed or malicious markdown can break the JSON payload construction or render incorrectly in the GitHub UI.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:9991-9997 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The cycle-level status computation can overwrite terminal `validated` with `ready`.
  WHY: The decision block recomputes `_completion_status_text` fresh every poll tick without preserving a previously validated terminal state.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10018-10022 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Issues with status `implementation-failed` appear in both the pending and failed sections.
  WHY: The pending filter excludes `merged`, `closed`, and `skipped` but not `implementation-failed`, while the failed filter explicitly includes it.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10039-10043 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The pending filter still lets the same issue show up in multiple display lists.
  WHY: The filter needs an `implementation-failed` exclusion to prevent duplication.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~4714-4721 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new validation preflight can race the first poll cycle before `PROJECT_COMPLETE` is initialized.
  WHY: The guard checks `PROJECT_COMPLETE` before the wave-status block sets it, so the first cycle is not actually gated.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~1279-1320 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Silent API failures unconditionally write the body-hash cache and poison idempotency.
  WHY: The `gh api` calls are wrapped in `|| true`, but the cache write still happens afterward, so transient failures become permanent skips.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10050-10053 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `completion_status_failure_alert_sent` update has no error handling around `mv`.
  WHY: If the move fails, the state file is not updated and the Telegram alert can fire again on a later cycle.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~1335-1343 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: An empty `COMMENTS` cache can leave `existing_id` blank and make the helper POST instead of PATCH.
  WHY: The jq lookup can return empty, and the fallback path then creates duplicate completion-status comments instead of editing the existing one.
=== END FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===

  WHY: The `gh_retry gh api` calls swallow failures, but the cache write happens unconditionally, so future cycles skip retrying even though the comment was not updated.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10050-10053 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `completion_status_failure_alert_sent` flag update does not detect `mv` failure.
  WHY: If the move fails, the state file stays unchanged and the Telegram alert can be emitted again on a later cycle.
